news.title: Headmaster detained after BBC investigation into alleged sexual abuse of students
news.summary: Former students launched their own investigation, spending years collecting evidence and testimonies from others who say they were abused by the headteacher.

news.title: Guterres alerta de los riesgos de la escalada de violencia en Etiopía e insta al cese "inmediato" de las hostilidades
news.summary: El secretario general de Naciones Unidas, António Guterres, se ha mostrado "profundamente preocupado" por el incremento de la violencia en el norte de Etiopía y ha alertado de los riesgos de una nueva escalada para la estabilidad y la seguridad regionales, al tiempo que ha apelado a "todas las partes" para exigir el fin de los enfrentamientos en el país y con Estados vecinos.

news.title: Nueve muertos en un tiroteo en Pensilvania, EEUU
news.summary: Nueve personas han muerto en un tiroteo ocurrido en la noche del viernes en la localidad de Erie, en Pensilvania, Estados Unidos, según han confirmado las autoridades.

news.title: Trump anuncia acordo com Putin para liberar diesel russo para mercado mundial
news.summary: O presidente da Ucrânia criticou duramente a medida, dizendo que Putin está recebendo um "presente" dos EUA.

news.title: O que se sabe sobre forte terremoto de magnitude 7,7 que atingiu o Panamá
news.summary: O presidente do país disse que o desastre que seu país enfrenta "é grande" — mas não foram registradas vítimas até agora.

news.title: U.S. and Russia tout diesel deal to ease sanctions and reopen fuel flows
news.summary: Moscow and Washington tout a diesel deal to ease sanctions and reopen fuel flows, but few details leave questions on price impacts and U.S. policy, sparking anger from Ukraine and allies.

news.title: US midterms: Women candidates could make history
news.summary: The US is holding Congress and state governors elections. At all levels of US politics, women are underrepresented — but they may win some historic victories in the midterms on November 3.

news.title: October 7 scars push Israel's first-time voters to right
news.summary: Like hundreds of thousands of Israelis, Amihai will be of voting age for the first time since Hamas carried out its attack on October 7, 2023. When he casts his ballot this month, he has one priority above all -- security.

news.title: Hunger and malnutrition stalk Gazans, a year on from ceasefire
news.summary: Every day, Gazan mother Niyaha al-Masri spends six exhausting hours or more queueing at a community kitchen in the hope of getting some food for her family. It has been a year since a ceasefire between Hamas and Israel was supposed to allow food to flood into the ruined territory, yet widespread hunger persists there.

news.title: La UE concede a España un préstamo por valor de mil millones de euros para ampliación de sus capacidades defensivas
news.summary: El comisario europeo de Defensa y Espacio, Andrius Kubilius, ha anunciado este sábado la concesión á España de un préstamo de mil millones de euros para la adquisición de material de defensa, dentro del instrumento SAFE (por sus siglas en inglés), tal y como anunció a comienzos de este año la Comisión Europea.

news.title: Como Jair Bolsonaro quase conseguiu em 2022 a virada que Lula almeja no 2º turno
news.summary: Em 2022, Jair Bolsonaro elevou seus votos em quase 14% entre os dois turnos, enquanto Lula cresceu só pouco mais de 5%: é o movimento que a campanha do petista almeja fazer agora.

news.title: Rusia anuncia la toma de dos localidades en Járkov, Ucrania
news.summary: El Ministerio de Defensa ruso ha informado este sábado de la captura de las localidades de Lukashovo y Lobanovka, en la región de Járkov, en el este de Ucrania, en el marco de la invasión militar contra este país lanzada en 2022.

news.title: Severe injuries at French student protests draw scrutiny to police tactics
news.summary: Twenty-four investigations have been opened by French police watchdog IGPN into incidents linked to the ongoing high school protest movement, the interior ministry said. The police response has reignited calls to scrap rubber bullets and launcher-fired riot-control weapons, long denounced by rights groups and UN experts as dangerous and excessive.

news.title: Rogue Anthropic AI agent gave police fake tip in unsolved murder case
news.summary: Philadelphia police said the tip was "flagged as spam", but criticised the tech company for taking more than two months to detect and report the breach.

news.title: El TPI condena las sanciones de EEUU contra la institución como "un ataque al orden jurídico internacional"
news.summary: El Tribunal Penal Internacional (TPI) ha rechazado "enérgicamente" las sanciones interpuestas por Estados Unidos contra la institución, una decisión que considera un intento de obstaculizar su labor judicial y que se suma a las medias adoptadas previamente contra trece de sus jueces y fiscales, todas ellas --ha denunciado-- en detrimento del orden jurídico internacional.

news.title: Suspect killed after 13 kindergarteners taken hostage, beaten in Brazil
news.summary: Man spreads flammable liquid in a room with 13 children while holding a lighter as police try to negotiate.

news.title: A year after the ‘ceasefire’, Gaza’s healthcare is still collapsing
news.summary: Continuing attacks, restrictions on medical aid and delayed evacuations are still killing Palestinians.

news.title: Journalist Hamurabi Huesca Manzano killed in Mexico’s Oaxaca
news.summary: Conflicting reports emerge on the circumstances of the killing, prompting calls for justice from advocacy groups.

news.title: Navanethem 'Navi' Pillay wins the Nobel Peace Prize
news.summary: Former UN human rights chief Navanethem "Navi" Pillay, a judge at the International Court of Justice, won the Nobel Peace Prize on Friday in Oslo, Norway.

news.title: India's 'cockroach' movement: "This is unprecedented"
news.summary: Indian police detained Abhijeet Dipke, head of the satirical Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) movement, on Saturday ahead of a major protest against the Election Commission, the party said. "This is unprecedented," our guest Subir Sinha, director of the SOAS South Asia Institute, says.

news.title: India detains 'cockroach' leaders ahead of election protest
news.summary: Indian police detained the head of the satirical "cockroach" online movement on Saturday, the group said, ahead of a major protest against the Election Commission that triggered strict security measures. Our correspondent Navodita Kumari tells us more.

news.title: France: Scientists conduct microgravity experiments on parabolic flights
news.summary: This week in Bordeaux, the CNES, the French space agency, launched a microgravity research campaign with scientists from all over the world. It gave them the opportunity to conduct experiments in weightlessness during parabolic flights aboard a specially equipped Airbus, without having to send their equipment into space. Our reporters James André and Sylvain Rousseau joined them on board.

news.title: Brazil police rescue 13 children taken hostage at kindergarten
news.summary: Brazilian police have rescued 13 children held hostage for more than two hours at a daycare centre in Curitiba.

news.title: Trump hails Russia deal to release diesel as midterms loom
news.summary: US President Donald Trump said Friday that he had secured Russia's agreement for a major release of diesel, as he eased war sanctions on Moscow in a push to lower energy costs ahead of midterm elections.

news.title: A arrancada de Flávio Bolsonaro: Por Que Isso Importa #3
news.summary: Podcast do Poder360 analisa os principais temas políticos da semana que se encerra

news.title: CEO da Ford defende parcerias com empresas chinesas
news.summary: Jim Farley diz que acordos dão acesso a tecnologias para veículos elétricos e ajudam a criar empregos nos EUA, apesar da pressão política contra Pequim

news.title: Infra em 1 Minuto: inverno no hemisfério Norte gera aperto do GNL
news.summary: Pedro Rodrigues alerta que crise no Oriente Médio e disputa por gás elevam preços e reforçam importância da produção nacional
